scheme_name: Small Industries Unit for Persons with Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana.
Applicant must have a disability of at least 40%.
Applicant must be over 18 years old, except for persons with mental retardation where the minimum age is 14 years.
benefits_summary: Loan assistance of up to ₹25 lakh for setting up manufacturing, fabrication, and production units.
